## Disciplines & Core Competencies
- Artificial Intelligence: Autonomous multi-agent systems, AI governance and safety harnesses, universal LLM harnesses, local inference optimization, model routing, reinforcement learning.
- Formal Methods & Control Theory: Z3 SMT verification, Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), Signal Temporal Logic (STL), Lyapunov stability, Control Barrier Functions, invariant checking.
- Mathematics: Optimization, probability, graph structures, algebraic topology (Betti numbers), phase transition analysis, cooperative game theory (Shapley values, mechanism design).
- Distributed Systems: CRDT-based distributed state, Byzantine fault tolerance, deterministic merging, partition handling, distributed transactions with escrow mechanisms.
- Systems & Low-Level Engineering: Custom operating systems (kernel, memory management, scheduling), runtime engines, compiler design for constrained hardware, Linux internals.
- Hardware Engineering: Board-level diagnostics using soldering iron and multimeter, salvaged PC assembly, embedded electronics (ESP8266, Raspberry Pi), home automation, custom Android kernels and ROM debugging.

## Key Projects

### POLARIS
- Role: AI Governance and Sovereign Intelligence Engine
- Summary: A universal, model-agnostic harness that enforces safety, governance, and provenance constraints on arbitrary LLMs without requiring model retraining.
- Architecture: Combines multi-agent reasoning with formal verification (Z3), topological and phase-transition analysis, game-theoretic mechanisms, and Byzantine resilience.

### SENTINEL
- Role: Autonomous Incident Response System
- Summary: An autonomous SRE architecture employing specialized cooperating agents and tool integrations for incident detection, blast-radius calculation, confidence scoring with temporal decay, and human approval gates. Built for the ANVIL Hackathon.

### ANDROMEDA
- Role: CRDT-Based Distributed OLTP Engine
- Summary: A distributed transactional engine exploring how relational invariants (foreign keys, uniqueness via escrow) can be preserved deterministically under network partitions and concurrent writes.

### INDRA
- Role: Citizen State-Transition Engine for Public Infrastructure
- Summary: Ranked 45 and Top 250 at Build What Moves India. Workflow execution and reconciliation platform designed to survive intermittent service outages with transactional integrity, state resumption, and cryptographic provenance.

### NEBULA
- Role: Persistent Context Engine for Autonomous SRE
- Summary: Transforms raw operational telemetry and incident history into persistent, evolving topological memory for recurring failure diagnosis.

### ZENITH
- Role: Precision-Controlled Memory Agent
- Summary: Investigates per-dimension attractor control in agent memory architectures, exploring extensions of attractor dynamics in autonomous agents.

### GARGANTUA
- Role: Unified Autonomous Intelligence Meta-Architecture
- Summary: An overarching framework integrating reasoning, governance, memory, infrastructure, distributed state, and autonomous execution layers.

### CHIMERA
- Role: Autonomous Intelligence Architecture
- Summary: An evolving technical specification for hierarchical agents, multi-model routing, speculative local inference, planning, and verification.

### NEURAL COMPILER
- Role: Experimental Runtime for Large Workloads on Constrained Hardware
- Summary: Explores execution optimization, model compression, and runtime efficiency on constrained machines.

### UntitledOS
- Role: Custom Operating System
- Summary: An operating system written from scratch covering boot protocols, kernel architecture, memory management, drivers, scheduler, and interactive shell.
